sources.snippet: In this blog, we will give an in-detail explanation of how XLS-R - more specifically the pre-trained checkpoint Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M - can be fine-tuned for ASR. For demonstration purposes, we fine-tune the model on the low resource ASR dataset of Common Voice that contains only ca. 4h of validated training data. sources.title: fairseq/examples/wav2vec/xlsr/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: XLS-R is a set of large-scale models for self-supervised cross-lingual speech representation learning based on wav2vec 2.0. It was pretrained on 128 languages and approximately 436K hours of unlabeled speech data.
